verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Atunci a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων, λάλησον τῷ Ἀαρὼν,

verses.geez:
ንግሮ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወበሎ ፡ እምነ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ገቦሃ ፡ ዘገ[ጻ] ፡ አንብር ፡ መኃትዊሃ ፡ ለመራናት ፡ ወአኅትዎን ፡
                  ሰብዑሆን ፡ መኃትዊሃ ።
verses.translation: Speak to Aaron, and thou shalt say to him, Whenever thou shalt set the lamps in order, the seven lamps shall give light opposite the candlestick.

translations.lxx: Speak to Aaron, and thou shalt say to him, Whenever thou shalt set the lamps in order, the seven lamps shall give light opposite the candlestick.
translations.kjv: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
translations.ron: "Vorbeşte cu Aaron şi-i spune: Când vei pune candelele în sfeşnic, ca să lumineze partea cea dinaintea lui, să aprinzi în el şapte candele".
translations.grk: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτὸν, ὅταν ἐπιτιθῇς τοὺς λύχνους ἐκ μέρους, κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς λυχνίας φωτιοῦσιν οἱ ἑπτὰ λύχνοι.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ አሮን ፡ እምአሐዱ ፡ ገቦሃ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ገ[ጻ] ፡ ለመራናት ፡ አሕተወ ፡ መኃትዊሃ ፡ በከመ ፡
                  አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron did so: on one side opposite the candlestick he lighted its lamps, as the Lord appointed Moses.

translations.lxx: And Aaron did so: on one side opposite the candlestick he lighted its lamps, as the Lord appointed Moses.
translations.kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Şi a făcut Aaron aşa: a aprins în sfeşnic, ca să lumineze partea cea din faţa lui, şapte candele, cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησεν οὕτως Ἀαρών· ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς μέρους κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς λυχνίας ἐξῆψε τοὺς λύχνους αὐτῆς, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ·

verses.geez:
ወከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ግብረታ ፡ ለመራናት ፡ ወአዕጹቂሃኒ ፡ ጽኑዓን ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ኵለንታሆሙ ፡ ወ[ጽጌ] ያቲሃኒ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡
                  ኵለንታሁ ፡ በከመ ፡ አርአያ ፡ ዘአርአዮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ገብራ ፡ ለመራናት ።
verses.translation: And this is the construction of the candlestick: it is solid, golden—its stem, and its lilies—all solid: according to the pattern which the Lord shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

translations.lxx: And this is the construction of the candlestick: it is solid, golden—its stem, and its lilies—all solid: according to the pattern which the Lord shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
translations.kjv: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
translations.ron: Iată cum era făcut sfeşnicul: fusul lui de aur era lucrat din ciocan; florile lui toate erau tot din ciocan. După modelul pe care îl arătase Domnul lui Moise, aşa s-a făcut sfeşnicul.
translations.grk: Καὶ αὕτη ἡ κατασκευὴ τῆς λυχνίας· στερεὰ, χρυσῆ, ὁ καυλὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰ κρίνα αὐτῆς, στερεὰ ὅλη· κατὰ τὸ εἶδος ὃ ἔδειξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ, οὕτως ἐποίησε τὴν λυχνίαν.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit cu Moise Domnul şi i-a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων,

verses.geez: ንሥኦሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአንጽሖሙ ።
verses.translation: Take the Levites out of the midst of the children of Israel, and thou shalt purify them.

translations.lxx: Take the Levites out of the midst of the children of Israel, and thou shalt purify them.
translations.kjv: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
translations.ron: "Ia pe leviţi din mijlocul fiilor lui Israel şi-i curăţă;
translations.grk: λάβε τοὺς Λευίτας ἐκ μέσου υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀφαγνιεῖς αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወከመዝ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ከመ ፡ ታንጽሖሙ ፡ ትነዝኆሙ ፡ ማየ ፡ አንጽሖ ፡ ወይላጽዩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሥጋሆሙ ፡ ወይሕፅቡ ፡
                  አልባሲሆሙ ፡ ወንጹሓነ ፡ ይከውኑ ።
verses.translation: And thus shalt thou perform their purification: thou shalt sprinkle them with water of purification, and a razor shall come upon the whole of their body, and they shall wash their garments, and shall be clean.

translations.lxx: And thus shalt thou perform their purification: thou shalt sprinkle them with water of purification, and a razor shall come upon the whole of their body, and they shall wash their garments, and shall be clean.
translations.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
translations.ron: Şi ca să-i cureţi, să faci cu ei aşa: să-i stropeşti cu apa curăţirii, să-şi radă cu briciul tot trupul lor, să-şi spele hainele şi vor fi curaţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὕτω ποιήσεις αὐτοῖς τὸν ἁγνισμὸν αὐτῶν· περιῤῥανεῖς αὐτοὺς ὕδωρ ἁγνισμοῦ· καὶ ἐπελεύσεται ξυρὸν ἐπὶ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτῶν, καὶ πλυνοῦσι τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν, καὶ καθαροὶ ἔσονται.

verses.geez:
ወይንሥኡ ፡ ላህመ ፡ አሐደ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ወሎቱኒ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ስንዳሌ ፡ ዘግበር ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ወላህም ፡
                  ዘዓመት ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ይንሥኡ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: And they shall take one calf of the herd, and its meat-offering, fine flour mingled with oil: and thou shalt take a calf of a year old of the herd for a sin-offering.

translations.lxx: And they shall take one calf of the herd, and its meat-offering, fine flour mingled with oil: and thou shalt take a calf of a year old of the herd for a sin-offering.
translations.kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
translations.ron: Apoi ei să ia un viţel şi prinosul de pâine, făină de grâu, amestecată cu untdelemn; iar tu să mai iei un viţel, jertfă pentru păcat.
translations.grk: Καὶ λήμψονται μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν, καὶ τούτου θυσίαν σεμίδαλιν ἀναπεποιημένην ἐν ἐλαίῳ· καὶ μόσχον ἐνιαύσιον ἐκ βοῶν λήψῃ περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez: ወታመጽኦሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወታስተጋብእ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of witness; and thou shalt assemble all the congregation of the sons of Israel.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of witness; and thou shalt assemble all the congregation of the sons of Israel.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
translations.ron: Adu după aceea pe leviţi înaintea cortului adunării, unde vei aduna toată obştea fiilor lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσάξεις τοὺς Λευίτας ἔναντι τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου· καὶ συνάξεις πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ·

verses.geez: ወታመጽኦሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይወድዩ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሌዋውያን ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord; and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord; and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
translations.ron: Să se apropie leviţii înaintea Domnului şi fiii lui Israel să-şi pună mâinile pe leviţi;
translations.grk: Καὶ προσάξεις τοὺς Λευίτας ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἐπιθήσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τοὺς Λευίτας·

verses.geez:
ወይፈልጦሙ ፡ አሮን ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይከውኑ ፡ ለግብረ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron shall separate the Levites for a gift before the Lord from the children of Israel: and they shall be prepared to perform the works of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And Aaron shall separate the Levites for a gift before the Lord from the children of Israel: and they shall be prepared to perform the works of the Lord.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
translations.ron: Iar Aaron să afierosească pe leviţi înaintea Domnului, din partea fiilor lui Israel, ca să facă ei slujbă Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀφοριεῖ Ἀαρὼν τοὺς Λευίτας ἀπόδομα ἔναντι Κυρίου παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἔσονται ὥστε ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወሌዋውያን ፡ ይወድዩ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ዲበ ፡ አርእስተ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ወይገብር ፡ አሐደ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወአሐደ ፡
                  ለመሥዋዕተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያስተሰሪ ፡ በእንቲአሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the calves; and thou shalt offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord, to make atonement for them.

translations.lxx: And the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the calves; and thou shalt offer one for a sin-offering, and the other for a whole-burnt-offering to the Lord, to make atonement for them.
translations.kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
translations.ron: Apoi leviţii să-şi pună mâinile pe capetele viţeilor şi tu să aduci unul jertfă pentru păcat, iar pe celălalt ardere de tot Domnului pentru curăţirea leviţilor.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ Λευῖται ἐπιθήσονσι τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν μόσχων· καὶ ποιήσεις τὸν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ τὸν ἕνα εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα Κυρίῳ, ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወታቀውሞሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወቅድመ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወቅድመ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ወታገብኦሙ ፡ ሀብቶ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the Levites before the Lord, and before Aaron, and before his sons; and thou shalt give them as a gift before the Lord.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt set the Levites before the Lord, and before Aaron, and before his sons; and thou shalt give them as a gift before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
translations.ron: Pune apoi pe leviţi înaintea Domnului şi înaintea lui Aaron şi înaintea fiilor lui şi-i adu dar Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ στήσεις τοὺς Λευίτας ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἔναντι Ἀαρὼν, καὶ ἔναντι τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀποδώσεις αὐτοὺς ἀπόδομα ἔναντι Κυρίου·

verses.geez: ወትፈልጦሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይከውኑ ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt separate the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and they shall be mine.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt separate the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and they shall be mine.
translations.kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
translations.ron: Aşa vei osebi pe leviţi de fiii lui Israel, că vor fi ai Mei.
translations.grk: Καὶ διαστελεῖς τοὺς Λευίτας ἐκ μέσου υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· καὶ ἔσονταί μοι.

verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይበውኡ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወታነጽሖሙ ፡ ወታገብኦሙ ፡ ቅድመ
                  ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And afterwards the Levites shall go in to perform the works of the tabernacle of witness; and thou shalt purify them, and present them before the Lord.

translations.lxx: And afterwards the Levites shall go in to perform the works of the tabernacle of witness; and thou shalt purify them, and present them before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
translations.ron: După aceea vor merge leviţii să slujească la cortul adunării, după ce îi vei curăţi şi îi vei afierosi Domnului;
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσονται οἱ Λευῖται ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίον· καὶ καθαριεῖς αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἀποδώσεις αὐτοὺς ἔναντι Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ሀብተ ፡ ገብኡ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይፈትሕ ፡
                  ማኅፀነ ፡ ዘእምኵሉ ፡ በኵሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ነሣእክዎሙ ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.translation: For these are given to me for a present out of the midst of the children of Israel: I have taken them to myself instead of all the first-born of the sons of Israel that open every womb.

translations.lxx: For these are given to me for a present out of the midst of the children of Israel: I have taken them to myself instead of all the first-born of the sons of Israel that open every womb.
translations.kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
translations.ron: Căci Îmi sunt daţi Mie dintre fiii lui Israel în locul tuturor celor întâi-născuţi, care deschide orice pântece;
translations.grk: ὅτι ἀπόδομα ἀποδεδομένοι οὗτοί μοι εἰσὶν ἐκ μέσου υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· ἀντὶ τῶν διανοιγόντων πᾶσαν μήτραν πρωτοτόκων πάντων ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ εἴληφα αὐτοὺς ἐμοί.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ በኵር ፡ ዘእምደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምነ ፡ ሰብኡ ፡ እስከ ፡ እንስሳሁ ፤ በዕለት ፡
                  እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ቀተልክዎሙ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ በኵር ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ዘቀደስክዎሙ ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.translation: For every first-born among the children of Israel is mine, whether of man or beast: in the day in which I smote every first-born in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them to myself.

translations.lxx: For every first-born among the children of Israel is mine, whether of man or beast: in the day in which I smote every first-born in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them to myself.
translations.kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
translations.ron: Căci al Meu este tot întâi-născutul lui Israel, de la om până la dobitoc, pentru că Mi i-am sfinţit Mie în ziua când am lovit în pământul Egiptului pe toţi întâi-născuţii;
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐμοὶ πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπων ἕως κτήνους· ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐπάταξα πᾶν πρωτότοκον ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου, ἡγίασα αὐτοὺς ἐμοὶ,

verses.geez: ወነሣእክዎሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ በኵር ፡ ዘእምደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And I took the Levites in the place of every first-born among the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And I took the Levites in the place of every first-born among the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi în locul tuturor întâi-născuţilor fiilor lui Israel am luat pe leviţi;
translations.grk: καὶ ἔλαβον τοὺς Λευίτας ἀντὶ παντὸς πρωτοτόκου ἐν υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወአግባእክዎሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ሀብተ ፡ ወተውህቡ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወያስተሰርዩ ፡ በእንቲአሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡
                  እስራኤል ፡ ወአልቦቱ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዘይቀርብ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ እምደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And I gave the Levites presented as a gift to Aaron and his sons out of the midst of the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of witness, and to make atonement for the children of Israel: thus there shall be none among the sons of Israel to draw nigh to the holy things.

translations.lxx: And I gave the Levites presented as a gift to Aaron and his sons out of the midst of the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of witness, and to make atonement for the children of Israel: thus there shall be none among the sons of Israel to draw nigh to the holy things.
translations.kjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
translations.ron: Şi i-am dat pe leviţi dar lui Aaron şi fiilor lui dintre fiii lui Israel, ca să slujească pentru fiii lui Israel, la cortul adunării şi să se roage pentru fiii lui Israel, ca să nu-i ajungă pe fiii lui Israel vreo urgie, când s-ar apropia de locaşul sfânt".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέδωκα τοὺς Λευίτας ἀπόδομα δεδομένους Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ ἐκ μέσου υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ ἐξιλάσκεσθαι περὶ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ προσεγγίζων πρὸς τὰ ἅγια.

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘሆ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ገብሩ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites as the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the sons of Israel did to them.

translations.lxx: And Moses and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites as the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the sons of Israel did to them.
translations.kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
translations.ron: Moise şi Aaron şi toată obştea fiilor lui Israel au făcut cu leviţii cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise pentru leviţi; aşa au făcut cu ei fiii lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησε Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ τοῖς Λευίταις καθὰ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ περὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν, οὕτως ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወአንጹሑ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ ወኀፀቡ ፡ አልባሲሆሙ ፡ ወአግብእዎሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አሮን ፡ ሀብ[ተ] ፡ ቅድመ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአስተስረየ ፡ በእንቲአሆሙ ፡ አሮን ፡ ከመ ፡ ያንጽሖሙ ።
verses.translation: So the Levites purified themselves and washed their garments; and Aaron presented them as a gift before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement for them to purify them.

translations.lxx: So the Levites purified themselves and washed their garments; and Aaron presented them as a gift before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement for them to purify them.
translations.kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
translations.ron: S-au curăţit deci leviţii şi şi-au spălat hainele, iar Aaron a săvârşit sfinţirea lor înaintea Domnului şi s-a rugat pentru ei, ca să fie curaţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡγνίσαντο οἱ Λευῖται, καὶ ἐπλύναντο τὰ ἱμάτια· καὶ ἀπέδωκεν αὐτοὺς Ἀαρὼν ἀπόδομα ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἐξιλάσατο περὶ αὐτῶν Ἀαρὼν ἀφαγνίσασθαι αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ቦኡ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ግብሮሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወቅድመ
                  ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ገብሩ ፡ ሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And afterwards the Levites went in to minister in their service in the tabernacle of witness before Aaron, and before his sons; as the Lord appointed Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

translations.lxx: And afterwards the Levites went in to minister in their service in the tabernacle of witness before Aaron, and before his sons; as the Lord appointed Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
translations.kjv: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
translations.ron: După aceea au intrat leviţii să-şi facă slujbele lor la cortul adunării, înaintea lui Aaron şi înaintea fiilor lui. Cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise pentru leviţi, aşa au făcut cu ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσῆλθον οἱ Λευῖται λειτουργεῖν τὴν λειτουργίαν αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἔναντι Ἀαρὼν, καὶ ἔναντι τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ· καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ περὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν, οὕτως ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ ዘእምዕሥራ ፡ ወኀምስቱ ፡ ዓም ፡ ወላዕሉ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ይበውኡ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡
                  ግብሮሙ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: This is the ordinance for the Levites; From five and twenty years old and upward, they shall go in to minister in the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: This is the ordinance for the Levites; From five and twenty years old and upward, they shall go in to minister in the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
translations.ron: "Aceasta este legea leviţilor: de la douăzeci şi cinci de ani în sus să intre să lucreze la cortul adunării;
translations.grk: τοῦτό ἐστι τὸ περὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν· ἀπὸ πέντε καὶ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω, εἰσελεύσονται ἐνεργεῖν ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου·

verses.geez: ወዘእምኀምሳ ፡ ይሰዐር ፡ እምግብሩ ፡ ወኢይትቀነይ ፡ እንከ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And from fifty years old the Levite shall cease from the ministry, and shall not work any longer.

translations.lxx: And from fifty years old the Levite shall cease from the ministry, and shall not work any longer.
translations.kjv: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
translations.ron: Iar la cincizeci de ani să înceteze şi să nu mai lucreze.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ πεντηκονταετοῦς ἀποστήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς λειτουργίας, καὶ οὐκ ἐργᾶται ἔτι.

verses.geez:
ወይትለአ[ክ] ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወይዕቀብ ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ፡ ወተቀንዮ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ [ኢ]ይትቀነዩ ፡
                  ወከመዝ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ በበ ፡ ሕቢቶሙ ።
verses.translation: And his brother shall serve in the tabernacle of witness to keep charges, but he shall not do works: so shalt thou do to the Levites in their charges.

translations.lxx: And his brother shall serve in the tabernacle of witness to keep charges, but he shall not do works: so shalt thou do to the Levites in their charges.
translations.kjv: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
translations.ron: De acolo înainte să ajute fraţilor lor a străjui la cortul adunării, dar de lucrat să nu mai lucreze. Aşa să faci cu leviţii, ca fiecare să fie la slujba lui de paznic".
translations.grk: Καὶ λειτουργήσει ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὑτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου φυλάσσειν φυλακὰς, ἔργα δὲ οὐκ ἐργᾶται· οὕτως ποιήσεις τοῖς Λευίταις ἐν ταῖς φυλακαῖς αὐτῶν.
